name: never-serve-broken-deck
body: The server must never present a partially broken deck: if validation fails (startup or reload) — including validation of the resolved library root (the configured `templates:` path, else the local `templates/`) — no slides are rendered: startup exits, reload shows the full-page error. A change to the configured `templates:` value while serving counts as serving a broken state: no slides are rendered and the full-page restart-required error is shown instead (see template-retarget-requires-restart).
